description: This file defines extension methods for integrating Kubernetes hosting support into Orleans silo builders and service collections. It provides methods to add Kubernetes hosting configurations and dependencies.

classes.name: KubernetesHostingExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for adding Kubernetes hosting support to Orleans silo builders and service collections.

methods.name: UseKubernetesHosting
methods.description: Adds Kubernetes hosting support to an ISiloBuilder with default options.

methods.name: UseKubernetesHosting
methods.description: Adds Kubernetes hosting support to an ISiloBuilder with custom options configured via a delegate.

methods.name: UseKubernetesHosting
methods.description: Adds Kubernetes hosting support to an IServiceCollection with default options.

methods.name: UseKubernetesHosting
methods.description: Adds Kubernetes hosting support to an IServiceCollection with custom options configured via a delegate.
